variety_description: High yielding, medium maturity, short stature, medium slender variety suitable for cultivation in saline prone areas under irrigated lowland conditions. Developed by BRRI and released in 2014 for planting in Boro season. Salt and cold tolerant. Susceptible to major diseases.
